title: River Development Agent Controlled Executor Accepted Receipt Handoff Foundation
objective: Construct a deterministic inert handoff from an accepted DEV-259 verified execution receipt decision for a future explicitly authorized downstream boundary without granting execution authorization, dispatch, executor invocation, retry, persistence, repository mutation, scope expansion, or external side-effect authority.
constraints: The DEV-260 foundation may consume only a DEV-259 acceptance result.
The DEV-259 result must be trusted, ready, accepted, DENY-by-default, and acceptance-decision-only.
The DEV-259 acceptance state must be VERIFIED_RECEIPT_ACCEPTED.
The handoff must remain inert data.
The handoff must preserve receipt state, executed operation, approved execution scope, provenance, authorization boundaries, and scope boundaries.
The handoff must not create execution authorization.
The handoff must not authorize downstream action.
The handoff must not dispatch.
The handoff must not invoke an executor.
The handoff must not execute an operation.
The handoff must not invoke an inspection dependency.
The handoff must not retry execution.
The handoff must not persist lifecycle state.
The handoff must not modify or delete repository content.
The handoff must not stage, commit, push, or deploy.
The handoff must not access secrets.
The handoff must not expand scope.
The handoff must not perform arbitrary shell execution.
The handoff must not perform external side effects.
Any future downstream action requires a separate explicit boundary.
